title: The quickstart's first command fails for the reader it is written for
foundBy: session agent, following README.md and INSTALL.md as a first-time reader

evidence.verified: Ran the block verbatim in an empty git repository: make exited 2 with "No rule to make target 'install'". The block now opens with the clone, which INSTALL.md's source route uses.

details:
The quickstart opened with "Build the tool and put a ledger in a repository that has none", then:

```bash
make install
cd ~/my-service
cs-ledger init ledger …
```

A reader who has not already cloned the repository gets `make: *** No rule to make target 'install'.  Stop.` The `cd ~/my-service` on the next line implies a starting directory the block never established.
